employer_base_contribution_rate.evidence: Les cotisations patronales de base pour la sécurité sociale s'élèvent à 25% du salaire brut pour le secteur marchand privé.

onss_contribution_branches.label: Sous-taux ONSS par branche (retraite, assurance maladie-invalidite, chomage, maladies professionnelles, accidents du travail)
onss_contribution_branches.evidence: Employee: pension 7.50%, sante-soins 3.55%, sante-indemnites 1.15%, chomage 0.87% (total 13.07%, matching the module's existing flat employee rate exactly). Employer: pension 8.86%, sante-soins 3.80%, sante-indemnites 2.35%, chomage 1.46%, maladies professionnelles 1.00%, accidents du travail 0.30% (these six branches total 17.77 points, leaving a 7.23-point residual against the module's existing 25.00% flat employer rate).
onss_contribution_branches.confidence: high for the seven directly-sourced sub-rates listed; the 7.23-point employer residual (family allowances, regionalized since 2015 but still consolidated in the ONSS base rate, plus smaller miscellaneous items such as conge-education paye) is a DERIVED value (25.00% minus the six sourced branches), not independently verified against a primary source
onss_contribution_branches.note: The employer branch amounts are computed 'before structural reduction' (gross wage x branch rate); the existing structural-reduction mechanism, which is not attributable to any single branch, continues to apply as a single lump-sum deduction against the branch total, unchanged from before this addition.

withholding_tax.label: Précompte professionnel
withholding_tax.evidence: Official page for the calculation of withholding tax, including 2026 rules.
withholding_tax.verification_note: The 4-bracket 2026 scale used in analysis/belgium/precompte_professionnel_2026.py (16,710/29,500/51,050 EUR thresholds at 26.75/42.80/48.15/53.50%) was re-checked 2026-08-31 against a second independent secondary source (calculateur-de-salaire.be), which reproduced the same four thresholds and rates, plus the same 30%/6,070 EUR professional-expense cap and basic-tax-reduction figures already in the code. A conflicting set of thresholds (16,310/28,790/49,820 EUR) surfaced in some other aggregator summaries during this check, but could not be traced to a primary source and is not corroborated elsewhere -- most likely a stale or conflated figure (e.g. the annual IPP tax-return scale rather than the précompte formule-clé scale, which use different year-ahead indexation). The code's existing values are treated as confirmed pending a direct check against Moniteur belge Annexe III (29 December 2025), which could not be fetched directly.
